theDifference.whyTheRenumberIsRight: main released contract 36 for INFRA-229's shapes without this branch's, so two different wire shapes would otherwise share one number. The boot gate takes api.DaemonAPIVersion and accepts only exact equality, and the controller mint and the claim registration refuse another contract, so a 36 plugin and a 37 daemon cannot meet; version_test.go, pi-legion's daemon-api-version.test.ts and claude-envoy's pin the equality.
